note: Fixtures whose reviewed repair is correct but which a recorded engine or harness defect stops the pipeline from carrying. An entry labels a failure; it never turns one into a pass, never leaves the precision, coverage, or abstention arithmetic, and never satisfies the release gate. Every entry names the defect's file and line so it cannot quietly absorb a new regression.

failures.note: The service generates its own coverage proof for a Python SQL finding whose repaired function takes a cursor or connection parameter, and that proof opens with `import psycopg` (services/remediation-service/src/proofs.py:268 and :272). Generated tests are dependency-checked with allow_declared=False, and _reject_missing_python_dependencies does not exempt the modules the Python harness fakes (services/remediation-service/src/sandbox/harness_py.py:665-671 installs flask, sqlite3, psycopg, psycopg2, pymysql, sqlalchemy, and subprocess into sys.modules, and _AutoStubFinder stubs anything else). The service therefore rejects a proof it wrote itself with missing_dependency:psycopg, the template pass and then every agent patch are refused, and no candidate is ever proposed. sqlite3 escapes it only by being standard library. Fixed by exempting the harness-provided modules in the generated-test dependency check, or by having the proof take its cursor from the harness instead of importing the driver.
